description: Latest weather readings and monthly rainfall history
summary: This page shows weather readings and monthly rainfall history for {district}, from the India Meteorological Department (IMD) and OpenWeatherMap. Temperature is in degrees Celsius and rainfall in millimetres. Each reading shows the time it was recorded.

explain.thenTempCond: When last recorded, on {when} IST, it was {temp} with {cond}.
explain.thenTemp: When last recorded, on {when} IST, it was {temp}.
explain.thenCond: When last recorded, on {when} IST, the weather showed {cond}.

rain.title: Rainfall
rain.yearExplain: In {period}, {actual} of rain fell in {district}. The normal for these months is {normal}, so this is {pct} of normal.
rain.months: Coloured drops are months that got at least their normal rain.
rain.monthsAria: {n, plural, one {# month} other {# months}} of {total} got at least normal rain.

monthly.title: Monthly rainfall, actual and normal
monthly.units: Millimetres of rain each month. Grey is the normal for that month, colour is what fell.
monthly.simple: Rain was below normal in {below} of the last {total} months.
monthly.simpleLatest: In {month}, {actual} fell against a normal of {normal}.

departure.title: Departure from normal
departure.units: Millimetres above or below the normal for each month
departure.simple: The wettest month compared with normal was {wet} ({wetBy}). The driest was {dry} ({dryBy}).
